summary: Lists the four steps to create a collection: init with ansible-galaxy (optionally from a custom template), add content, build an artifact, and publish to Galaxy.
questions: What are the steps to create and publish my own collection?
Which ansible-galaxy commands do I use to build and publish a collection?

answer_card.title: Steps to create a collection
answer_card.answer_md:
1. `ansible-galaxy collection init` (optionally with a custom template)
2. Add modules and other content
3. `ansible-galaxy collection build` to create the artifact
4. `ansible-galaxy collection publish` to Galaxy
